gui.ambience_garden.settings.title: Ambience Garden Settings
options.ambience_garden.debug.override.t: Suspend automatic ambience and hold the slider volumes below. Not saved. Turning this off discards every change and returns to normal selection.
options.ambience_garden.debug.volume.too: While override is on, this is the exact volume that plays. Live is what is audible right now.
options.ambience_garden.biomes.tooltip: Plays background sound based on the biome and time of day.
options.ambience_garden.environment.tool: Plays ambient sound based on where you are.
options.ambience_garden.audio_channel.to: Which vanilla volume slider these sounds follow. Defaults to Ambient.
options.ambience_garden.biome_volume.too: Volume of all biome ambient sounds. 100% is full volume.
options.ambience_garden.environment_volu: Volume of all environmental ambient sounds. 100% is full volume.
options.ambience_garden.cull_height.tool: Blocks above the ground at which ambient sounds fade out. 0 disables this.
options.ambience_garden.biome_blend.tool: Blocks to check for neighbouring biomes. 0 disables blending.
options.ambience_garden.alien.tooltip: Plays ambient sounds while anywhere in the End.
options.ambience_garden.bleak.tooltip: Plays ambient sounds in cold or barren overworld environments.
options.ambience_garden.dry.tooltip: Plays ambient sounds in dry or hot overworld environments.
options.ambience_garden.high.tooltip: Plays ambient sounds when high up in the overworld.
options.ambience_garden.night_plains.too: Plays ambient sounds in plains environments at night.
options.ambience_garden.snowstorm.toolti: Plays ambient sounds in a cold biome during a thunderstorm.
options.ambience_garden.village.tooltip: Plays ambient sounds inside a village.
options.ambience_garden.mansion.tooltip: Plays ambient sounds inside a woodland mansion.
options.ambience_garden.mineshaft.toolti: Plays ambient sounds from a nearby mineshaft.
options.ambience_garden.geode.tooltip: Plays ambient sounds from a nearby amethyst geode.
options.ambience_garden.gravel.tooltip: Plays ambient sounds underground near gravel.
options.ambience_garden.deepslate.toolti: Plays ambient sounds underground near deepslate.
options.ambience_garden.underground_wate: Plays water sounds from a nearby water source when underground.
options.ambience_garden.cave_drone.toolt: Plays a low drone when in a cave below the cutoff height.
options.ambience_garden.cave_depth.toolt: Plays more intense cave sounds below Y 0 when the light is low.
options.ambience_garden.cave_drone_cutof: Height at which the cave drone is silenced.
options.ambience_garden.cave_light.toolt: Light level at which cave ambience is dampened.
